title: Guide frontmatter
description: YAML frontmatter schema for catalogue-facing guide files under guides/.

title.description: Page title — used by the docs-site renderer as the heading.

summary.description: One-sentence description of what the reader gains from this page.

pack.description: Pack ID (matches a packs/ directory name) or '_shared' for cross-cutting guides.

kind.description: Diátaxis kind — a page contract, not a directory requirement.

slug.description: Override the public URL slug. Must start with 'guides/' to prevent clobbering non-guide pages. When present, build-site.py writes the file at this path regardless of physical source location.

journey.description: Optional journey association (slug of the journey page this guide belongs to).

order.description: Optional sort weight within a pack group for navigation generation.

aliases.description: Former public slugs (must start with 'guides/') that should redirect to this page. build-site.py generates a meta-refresh redirect stub at each alias path.

status.description: Optional publication status. Defaults to 'stable' when absent.

uses.description: Packs a reader needs for this page, shown as pills above the title. Defaults to `pack` when that is a real pack.
